title: Meta-analysis of radial artery harvesting techniques
author: Tzu-yen Huang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bhrdj526

steps.title: Define Search Parameters
steps.instruction: Establish research keywords and MeSH terms for the search.

steps.title: Perform Literature Search
steps.instruction: Search specific databases for studies published between January 1974 and July 2019.

steps.title: Screen and Select Articles
steps.instruction: Filter articles based on specific inclusion and exclusion criteria.

substeps.instruction: Include randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and non-randomized observational articles (prospective or retrospective) comparing open and endoscope artery harvesting in adult patients with coronary artery disease undergoing CABG
Exclude systemic-reviews, case series, and case reports
Exclude studies comparing open artery harvesting and minimal invasive radial artery harvesting

steps.title: Identify Primary Outcomes
steps.instruction: Extract data based on the following primary outcome measures:

substeps.instruction: Harvesting site neurological complications of the forearm during hospitalization
Patency rate (ranging from in-hospital to 3–5 years)

steps.title: Assess Study Quality and Bias
steps.instruction: Evaluate the risk of bias and methodological quality of the included studies.

substeps.instruction: Evaluate RCTs using the Revised Cochrane risk-of-bias tool for randomized trials (RoB 2)
Assess non-randomized controlled trials (NRCTs) using the Newcastle–Ottawa Quality Assessment Scale (NOS)

steps.title: Perform Data Synthesis
steps.instruction: Conduct data synthesis and statistical analysis using Review Manager.
